dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Data from two more users of the Inscribed Mirror. Hehe, if we get more good test data, then the product can be released soon...

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}, what's the matter? Any questions about the experiment... er, the trial challenge?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Since the Akasha is being used...

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Oh? You mean, "Why do we still use the Inscribed Mirror since we already are using Akasha technology," right?

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Considering the differences between animal and human brains, using the Akasha directly has a relatively high risk at this stage.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Also, as only the sense of vision is connected, though you may see from the animal's perspective, it's still your own body moving...

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Consider what would happen if connected to the vision of a bird. Visually, you are flying, and it is hard to control a fear of heights or your instinctual movement. It would definitely cause accidents...

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, so the mirrors are better for the time being.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: First hold the mirror in your hand, and then touch it to activate the response.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: The mirror is showing the animal's perspective now.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Of course, it has been edited. Many animals see the world very differently from us... but as it is made for people to use, we must tweak the image to be more acceptable.

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, Kshahrewar researchers wouldn't worry about that. How nice...

dialogues.speaker: Lamiya
dialogues.text: Hehe, hope you make it through the trial challenge smoothly... No! For the sake of the test data, you MUST complete the trial challenge at all costs!
